segments.thag1.53:1.1: “Vassati devo yathā sugītaṃ, channā me kuṭikā sukhā nivātā;
segments.thag1.53:1.3: Tassaṃ viharāmi appamatto, atha ce patthayasi pavassa devā”ti.

lines: Valliyattheragāthāyaṃ tassaṃ viharāmi appamattoti tassaṃ kuṭikāyaṃ appamādapaṭipattiyā matthakaṃ pāpitattā appamatto ariyavihārūpasaṃhitena dibbavihārādisaṃhitena ca iriyāpathavihārena viharāmi, attabhāvaṃ pavattemīti vuttaṃ hoti.
